title: CODATA 2022: the atomic unit of electric potential is 27.211 386 245 981 V
summary: The standard uncertainty is 0.000 000 000 030 V. This is the hartree expressed in volts.
body: The NIST 2022 listing prints 'atomic unit of electric potential 27.211 386 245 981' with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 030', unit V. The atomic unit of energy on the same listing is '4.359 744 722 2060 e-18' J with standard uncertainty '0.000 000 000 0048 e-18' J. The volt figure is the one to use when a card or a textbook says 'about 27.2 volts' and a reader needs the table's digits.
